notableIncidents.title: Elevated latency in the Responses API
notableIncidents.narrative: The Responses API experienced sustained elevated latency. The issue is currently under monitoring and remains unresolved.

notableIncidents.title: Embedding API Degraded · Embeddings API
notableIncidents.narrative: The Embeddings API suffered a significant degradation lasting over five days. Service has since been resolved.

notableIncidents.title: DeepSeek API 性能下降（DeepSeek API Degraded Performance）
notableIncidents.narrative: Degraded performance was observed across the DeepSeek API for a duration exceeding two days. The service was eventually restored.

notableIncidents.title: Outage in BC Clusters
notableIncidents.narrative: A major outage impacted the BC Clusters for nearly two days. Operations were successfully remediated.

notableIncidents.title: Inkling Small — down
notableIncidents.narrative: The Inkling Small model experienced a complete service outage lasting nearly 22 hours. Service has returned to normal.

notableIncidents.title: Flux 3 Launch Traffic
notableIncidents.narrative: Service experienced instability linked to Flux 3 launch traffic. The incident was resolved following the traffic spike.

observations: Treat Mistral API as high-risk for production workloads due to degrading reliability and long recovery windows.
Monitor OpenAI API latency closely if using the Responses API, as the issue is currently ongoing.
Utilize Modal for mission-critical tasks given its excellent reliability score and industry-leading recovery speed.
Account for extended recovery times when integrating DeepSeek or Black Forest Labs into time-sensitive pipelines.
Exercise caution with ChatGPT for real-time applications due to high average recovery durations.
